title: Empirically validate trace-intelligence composition on public and governed trajectories
description: Run a claim-aware empirical program that determines which trace-intelligence mechanisms add reliable information beyond exact and deterministic baselines. Public datasets validate canonicalization, selection, retrieval, diagnosis, stored-trace assertions, temporal facts, and deterministic replay; they do not validate employee skill, related Frankengate users, or enterprise intervention utility. All experiments must use task-level independence, frozen manifests, source and split hashes, loss receipts, task-cluster uncertainty, complete cost/failure lineage, and explicit negative results. The program is subordinate to the governed product epic bif-kyy.17.13 and GitHub #75; it supplies evidence to the Aurora-first gate bif-kyy.17.13.3.4 / GitHub #89 rather than creating a parallel production authority.
acceptance_criteria: Every experiment has a frozen manifest, immutable data and split revisions, code/prompt/model hashes, costs, failed attempts, exclusions, and lineage. Exact/deterministic baselines precede embeddings and LLM judges. Missing and reconstructed events remain typed. Public mechanism claims are separated from private enterprise claims. All six child vertical slices reach a documented build/kill/defer decision. The final architecture decision is human-reviewed; negative and null results are published.
notes: 2026-08-01 requirement-level completion audit published at experiments/summaries/program-completion-audit-2026-08-01.md. Status remains active_incomplete: ATIF/OTel, public mechanics, local PostgreSQL mechanics, issue/bead recording, and branch publication are proven at stated boundaries; CMU raw access is approval-gated; Aurora operations and causal enterprise outcomes remain unverified. make verify passes with 73 aggregate results, 43 manifests, 12 fixtures, and zero raw corpus files.

title: Build a licensed loss-aware public agent-trace corpus
description: Audit and admit complementary public trace strata: repeated tasks with independent outcomes, heterogeneous real harnesses, deterministic replay tasks, and importer-breadth formats. Record immutable revision, license, source task, harness, model, tools, outcome semantics, repeated IDs, bias, contamination, privacy, and redistribution status. Implement source adapters plus OTel/OpenInference and emit field-level information-loss receipts. Preserve every observed tool proposal, authorization, execution, result, state delta, branch, retry, fallback, delegation, outcome, and provenance event; mark reconstruction and missingness explicitly. Freeze task/repository/source-aware splits and keep raw traces out of Git.
acceptance_criteria: Dataset cards pin immutable revisions, licenses, outcome semantics, bias, privacy, and redistribution rights. Publishable corpus contains complementary repeated-task, heterogeneous-harness, and deterministic-replay strata or documents why a stratum is quarantined. Canonicalization preserves 100% of observed tool/outcome/authorization events in gold fixtures and at least 99.5% of typed events; reconstruction is explicit; import is deterministic and content-addressed. Conformance tests cover missing, redacted, reordered, duplicated, branched, fallback, and unknown events. Raw traces and credentials do not enter Git.
notes: 2026-07-31 checkpoint: dataset-manifest and canonical E0 projection tests ran 9/9 with no failures; raw traces remain out of Git. See experiments/summaries/corpus-admission-conformance-checkpoint-2026-07-31.md. ATIF v1.7 child closed with measured loss receipts. CMU admission and trajectory-level access remain deferred; parent corpus acceptance is not yet complete.

title: Detect friction localize decisive failures and promote stored traces to evals
description: Using the admitted public corpus, annotate blinded gold labels for review informativeness, friction taxonomy, decisive step, recovery delta, and eval candidacy. Compare random, length/cost, external outcome, each cheap signal, frozen signal union, and signal plus random audit. Run the invariants by ordered/modal evidence by calibrated-judge diagnosis factorial against first-error, last-error, and summary baselines. Require cited evidence IDs, alternatives, calibration, abstention, negative controls, and task-cluster uncertainty. Generate exact, ordered, unordered, forbidden-event, semantic, and independently observed state assertions; evaluate seeded mutants without describing retrospective audits as reruns.
acceptance_criteria: Critical gold labels meet the preregistered agreement threshold. Selection reports precision at fixed review budget and critical-case recall with random audit. Diagnosis reports task-cluster uncertainty, selective risk, top-k step accuracy, evidence entailment, calibration, latency, and token cost. Mutation tests report kill rate and allowed-variation false positives. Shuffled order, wrong time, removed decisive step, and irrelevant logs are negative controls. Any arm failing the frozen reliability or baseline gate is killed or redesigned.

title: Benchmark same-work retrieval and the Aurora replacement gate
description: On identical authorized candidates and blinded task-family hard negatives, compare exact identifiers, Aurora FTS and pg_trgm, structured task signatures, whole-prompt dense retrieval, separate objective/environment/failure/recovery views, hybrid fusion, reranking, and domain adaptation only after a named hard slice fails. Measure exact-ID recall, Recall@k, nDCG, MRR, hard negatives, calibration, RLS leakage, latency, storage, and cost. Exact vector search is the dense oracle before ANN. pg_textsearch remains a future extensible-PostgreSQL BM25 arm only if Aurora fails a frozen requirement; it is not an Aurora candidate or a reason to migrate.
acceptance_criteria: Frozen task-family and hard-negative labels are split by task/repository/source. Authorization is applied before scoring or an overfetch/recheck recall guarantee is measured. Exact identifiers never regress. Domain adaptation requires at least five absolute Recall@20 points on a frozen hard slice and transfer to private terminology. Leaving Aurora requires a frozen quality, latency, scale, or operations failure. Any pg_textsearch bakeoff includes selective RLS, churn, VACUUM, crash, failover, corruption, repair, and top-k-underfill tests.

title: Test temporal and procedural memory with causal replay
description: Compare flat summaries, source-cited candidate extraction, separate consolidation releases, and temporal/entity attributes under injected contradictions, corrections, validity windows, aliases, and collisions. Generate procedures from raw successes, summaries, failed-successful contrasts, separated orchestration/execution steps, and curated incremental playbooks. Freeze artifacts and randomly assign deterministic held-out tasks to no memory, relevant procedure, superficially similar placebo, and curated procedure. External verifiers and intention-to-treat determine success. No experiment writes live MEMORY.md; every fact and procedure remains a reviewed proposal with lineage.
acceptance_criteria: All facts and procedures cite immutable evidence. Candidate memory remains proposal-only. Temporal facts require 99% citation support, 95% factual precision, temporal and contradiction correctness, and zero scope leaks before private use. Replay compares relevant treatment with no-memory and unrelated placebo using external outcomes and multiple seeds. Report success, turns, attempts, tokens, cost, unsafe actions, verifier use, and correction burden. Kill procedures with no positive effect in two domains or excessive critical-slice harm.

title: Validate RLS-safe capability support and cross-user patterns
description: After public mechanism validation, test governed private traces under user, team, enterprise, classification, purpose, consent, retention, deletion, residency, minimum-cohort, and authorization-epoch controls. Establish source coverage and independently verified outcomes; label environment blockers and task capability requirements with insufficient-evidence, never infer a person trait from a failure. Show private suggestion cards before aggregates. Test anonymous pattern matching, reciprocal opt-in introductions, and randomized or stepped-wedge prompt/retrieval/eval/skill/memory interventions. Recompute or withdraw derived artifacts after policy changes and prevent unauthorized candidates from affecting scores, explanations, timing-visible counts, or aggregates.
acceptance_criteria: Every result carries principal, scope, classification, purpose, consent, and epoch lineage. Unauthorized candidates cannot influence scores, explanations, timing-visible counts, or aggregates. The system separates task capability requirements from person traits and abstains when environment, permission, tools, or context explain failure. Cross-user releases use minimum cohorts and resist differencing/re-identification. Named people search and automatic introductions are absent by default. Prospective suggestions demonstrate benefit and bounded harm before promotion.

title: Run trace-intelligence factorials and publish the architecture decision
description: Execute the preregistered E0-E7 program in dependency order and publish a reproducible paper artifact. Use task-cluster intervals, paired tests, registered corrections, and per-domain effects. Record model IDs, prompt hashes, seeds, tool schemas, tokens, prices, latency, failures, exclusions, and environments. Run deterministic/local arms first, economical models for extraction and setup, and frontier replication only after a lower-tier positive result. Publish negative and null results and explain which AgentRx, Signals, AgentEvals, temporal-memory, procedural-memory, and utility-routing mechanisms compose or conflict. Produce human-reviewed build, kill, or defer decisions; Aurora remains default unless bif-kyy.17.13.3.4 is satisfied.
acceptance_criteria: Every table and figure rebuilds from immutable manifests. Negative and null results are published. Costs are reported per useful reviewed finding and successful replay. The paper distinguishes compatible mechanisms from conflicts and public mechanism validation from enterprise claims. Each proposed component has a measured promotion gate and rollback. Aurora remains default unless bif-kyy.17.13.3.4 passes. Final build, kill, or defer decisions receive human approval.

title: Validate ATIF v1.7 as a loss-aware canonical projection
description: Implement canonical-to-ATIF and ATIF-to-canonical adapters at a pinned ATIF v1.7 revision. ATIF remains an import/export, evaluation, and training projection rather than the enterprise evidence authority. Preserve messages, tool proposal/call/result, reward, and artifacts when representable; emit a machine-readable receipt for governance/epoch, authorization, classification/purpose, retry/fallback/delegation, environment, temporal, redaction/deletion, and branch/DAG loss. Acceptance: deterministic round trips; no silently dropped events; fixtures cover missing results, parallel calls, retries, unknown kinds, redaction, branch, delegation, reward, and environment references; OTel/OpenInference remain separate loss-aware projections.
notes: 2026-07-30 real-family checkpoint: exact capability-fact round trips ran across 88 tool-rich Wisp coding trajectories / 17,293 events and 2,130 MATM ALFWorld trajectories / 25,885 events. Coding fact-weighted retention was ATIF 61.7% and OpenInference/OTel 64.6%; RL retention was ATIF 6.7% and OTel 32.7%. ATIF preserved coding tool calls/results but only 46.2% time and 32.3% replay identity; OTel preserved time/replay identity but only 83.3% calls and 80% results. Profile extensions are not portable-core guarantees. Canonical retained 100% of adapter-observed facts.
close_reason: Completed ATIF v1.7 loss-aware adapter and import/export tests. 21 focused tests pass; coding/RL retention results and non-portable loss receipts are published. ATIF remains a projection, not the evidence authority.

title: Admit CMU and the minimal complementary Hugging Face trace corpus
description: Admit cx-cmu/agent_trajectories after explicit contact-sharing access approval and select only the smallest complementary public corpus needed for missing evidence strata. Pin revisions, hashes, access terms, license/redistribution, task identity, tool visibility, rewards, contamination, and bias. Preserve trace_meta and benchmark reward. Treat 1,445 removed incomplete/crashed/truncated attempts as survivorship bias. Acceptance: task/environment-level splits; raw gated data never enters Git; exact generation-time tool-menu absence is typed; every candidate dataset receives admit/quarantine/reject rationale; redundant chat-only corpora are rejected.
notes: 2026-08-01 access recheck: authenticated Hugging Face identity pierretokns can read pinned dataset metadata and dry-run README.md, but dry-run tau2bench.parquet still returns repository approval denial. Metadata admitted; raw trajectories remain quarantined. No CMU files/metrics downloaded. See experiments/summaries/cmu-access-recheck-2026-08-01.md.

title: Build a governed OSS dreaming and skill-release baseline
description: Implement the minimal local dreaming baseline: governed evidence becomes typed fact/procedure/skill candidates, consolidation is copy-on-write and bitemporal, independent replay/review gates promotion, and released artifacts project into harness files only after approval. Acceptance: no direct mutation of live memory; immutable evidence citations and authority lineage; contradiction and deletion withdrawal; separate personal/team/enterprise gates; randomized no-memory/relevant/placebo/curated replay with external verifiers, multiple seeds, correction burden, unsafe-action rate, and rollback.
notes: 2026-07-30 checkpoints: Stage-0 tool execution and the earlier 18-assertion lifecycle remain mechanics-only. The audited natural cohort in 195dd6449 falsified basename-only latest memory with 3/6 cross-project placebo leaks while contextual identity passed 0/6. The bounded H5 suite in 06becb594 passed 26/26 PostgreSQL 16.12/pgvector 0.8.1 RLS/lifecycle assertions and zero rollback residue. Failed-job atomicity, concurrency, Aurora operations, extractor quality, human support, and causal benefit remain open under children .1.3 and .4.4.4.3. NL2SQL remains the primary causal skill domain.

title: Add environment reward and replay semantics to canonical trajectories
description: Add typed environment identity/version, reset/config, action, observation, state digest/reference, termination/truncation, reward components, verifier, and artifact lineage to the canonical event DAG. Define R0 retrospective audit, R1 tool-result replay, R2 environment replay from content-addressed snapshot, and R3 training rerun with learner lineage. Acceptance: never overclaim replay level; governed artifact refs for environment state; ATIF/OTel loss receipts; source-to-canonical-to-projection tests over representative BrowserGym/WebArena, tau2-bench, SWE-agent/SWE-Gym, Agent Lightning, OpenEnv, SkyRL/VERL, and AgentGym evidence.
notes: 2026-07-30 MATM schema-intersection checkpoint: all 2,130 pinned ALFWorld trajectories were converted and measured. OTel retained 100% event/replay identity but 0% reward, environment/reset state, and termination; ATIF retained 2.7% replay identity, 7.6% reward, 0% reset state, and 16.5% termination. Source MATM itself lacks environment seed and replay snapshot, so no projection can establish reset-equivalent replay. Next corpus must include frozen reset seed/snapshot and replay oracle.

title: Prove the governed PostgreSQL trace-intelligence architecture
description: Validate one PostgreSQL authority with typed policy columns, JSONB evidence, native FTS/trigram, and pgvector with authorization before candidate generation. Extend the completed 300-trace local pilot to selective authorized/unauthorized cardinality, top-k underfill/timing, epoch/membership/classification/purpose churn, deletion and derived withdrawal, concurrent ingest, partitioning, VACUUM/index rebuild, and failure recovery. Compare exact, structured, FTS, exact dense, ANN, hybrid, and reranking on identical authorized candidates. Real Aurora writer/failover/reader/RDS Proxy tests are required before production claims; no second query database without a frozen failure.
notes: 2026-07-31 live reruns: transaction-scoped H5 forced-RLS assertions passed against disposable colima PostgreSQL 16.12 + pgvector 0.8.1 and rolled back cleanly; H5 concurrency receipt semantically matched the committed result after timing normalization. See experiments/summaries/h5-forced-rls-rerun-check-2026-07-31.md and h5-concurrency-rerun-check-2026-07-31.md. Architecture gaps and Aurora/RDS Proxy boundary remain unchanged.

title: Validate real-user longitudinal harness histories
description: Admit intentionally published public Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Cursor, or related session histories whether redacted or unredacted. A declared license is recorded when present; NOASSERTION does not block analysis but does block unsupported redistribution or training-right claims. Implement source-native and derivative-aware adapters with loss receipts and content minimization. Preserve session, parent graph, tool calls/results and joins, compaction, subagents, malformed-record quarantine, timestamps, project metadata, provenance, and source hashes. Raw transcripts stay out of Git and aggregate secret-pattern candidates emit no values. Use public histories only for fidelity, longitudinal mechanisms, and ecological robustness, never employee scoring or a fictional public-data enterprise.
notes: Expanded 2026-07-30 correction: public native-history supply is ample. Fully paginated HF discovery found 359 agent-trace datasets; GitHub path search found 1,364 indexed Claude project JSONLs and 320 Codex session JSONLs. Top inspected repos include 2,362 native Claude files / 2.57 GB and 329 Codex rollouts / 280 MB. One genuine near-complete public .claude home-state tree was verified, plus thousand-file native session trees, real-device Codex bundles, and portable Claude session bundles. No equivalent complete Codex global home was verified. Strict path allowlisting is mandatory because 9/10 top Codex repos also contain .codex/auth* adjacent to sessions. Result comment: https://github.com/pierretokns/frankengate/issues/102#issuecomment-5132464543.
close_reason: Completed seven-representation public native-history fidelity study with full revisions, NOASSERTION admission policy, deterministic aggregates, tool/topology loss receipts, and zero raw committed corpora.

title: Run benchmark to real-user to enterprise transfer study
description: Run the three-tier evidence ladder: licensed benchmark mechanism qualification, intentionally donated real-user ecological stress testing, and consented prospective Frankengate transfer under RLS, authorization epoch, classification, purpose, retention, deletion, and consent policy. Map every original question to descriptive, hypothesis, prospective, or refused claim classes. Use independent outcomes, task-group splits, abstention, environment-blocker labels, randomized relevant/placebo/curated interventions, reciprocal opt-in collaboration, per-user canaries, rollback, and bounded-harm metrics. Publish supported, null, contradicted, and non-identifiable questions separately.

title: Run CodeTraceBench raw-trajectory E3/E4 factorial
description: Execute the blocked-test raw trajectory allowlist with complete action/observation sequences. Compare deterministic invariants, topology/modal evidence, calibrated judges, and combined arms; include evidence-removal and allowed-variation negative controls. Distinguish stored-trace audit from changed-system replay and require an independent verifier before any diagnosis claim.
notes: Completed 2026-07-30: all 145 available raw archives verified; 78 exactly aligned and 35 diagnosis-eligible. No deterministic factor beat reverse chronology; combined judge was brittle. Exact assertions overfit allowed variation; combined killed 96.9% harmful mutants with 48.6% benign false positives. No step-level causal verifier. Two runs byte-identical.
close_reason: Completed all-archive raw CodeTraceBench E3/E4 factorial with deterministic reruns, mutation controls, verifier audit, and conservative claim boundary.

title: Resolve MAST release conformance before multi-agent diagnosis claims
description: Obtain or produce a versioned finalized 14-mode human holdout overlapping judge-scored traces, evidence spans, stable taxonomy semantics including 3.2/3.3, and framework-held-out evaluation. Until satisfied, treat released MAST judge codes as noisy labels rather than gold.

title: Complete CMU trajectory access and licensing admission gate
description: An authorized human must review and accept cx-cmu/agent_trajectories gated access and clarify dataset reuse/redistribution terms. After approval, verify pinned file hashes, run the loss-aware adapter, publish aggregate-only metrics, and prohibit raw redistribution unless explicitly licensed.
notes: 2026-08-01 access recheck: authenticated metadata and README dry-run succeed for cx-cmu/agent_trajectories revision 88e2af82c116a9a57f29be6f21b9924da081c2bd, but tau2bench.parquet remains approval-gated. Keep admission/licensing gate open; no raw files downloaded.

title: Run real OpenTelemetry collector export and reimport conformance
description: Replace the sidecar-aware projection simulation with an actual pinned OpenTelemetry SDK/collector/exporter/storage round trip. Measure canonical ID, parent-edge, timing, content-redaction, tool-call, authority, and loss-receipt retention. No 100% OTel conformance claim until this passes.
notes: Completed 2026-07-30: real Go SDK v1.43.0 to otelcol-contrib v0.153.0 to batch/file OTLP JSON to canonical reimport retained 12/12 traces, 48/48 spans, 34/34 parents, and 16/16 links with zero content/authority-value attributes. Negative controls passed. Whole upstream trace drops require an out-of-band source/export manifest. Two runs byte-identical.
close_reason: Completed pinned real OTel SDK/Collector/exporter/reimport conformance with deterministic negative controls and documented source-manifest hard edge.

title: Instrument AgentTrace causal memory replay cohort
description: Convert 40 pinned NL2Bash tasks into a real causal replay cohort. Add verifier-owned expected stdout and filesystem-state digests, frozen model/sampling seeds, content-addressed environment snapshots, explicit proposal/execution IDs, and randomized no-memory, relevant-procedure, unrelated-placebo, and curated-procedure arms. Use external task verdicts and intention-to-treat; report success, attempts, turns, tokens, cost, unsafe actions, correction burden, and unsupported commands. Never treat collection completion, a gold command, or stdout/exit equality as task correctness.
notes: Tracked under GitHub issue #94; prerequisite negative result: https://github.com/pierretokns/frankengate/issues/94#issuecomment-5132213867.

title: Run E2 authorized hybrid retrieval factorial
description: Build a common labelled same-work retrieval slice and compare exact identifiers, structured filters, PostgreSQL full text, general embeddings, and hybrid retrieval under identical RLS/deletion/latency constraints. A custom embedding is gated on at least +5 absolute Recall@20 over the general hybrid baseline without authorization or deletion regression.
notes: 2026-07-31 coverage checkpoint: retrieval-focused tests ran 14/14 from research package root with no failures. Existing E2 result remains structured+dense Recall@20 0.8182 versus exact 0.7323; forced-RLS PostgreSQL hybrid was slower and rejected. Enterprise-question matrix limits retrieval evidence to Q1 mechanics and bounded screening; no custom embedding or backend replacement is authorized without labels, authorization/deletion parity, and scale evidence.

title: Build governed historical enterprise trace import plane
description: Implement one resumable control-plane import path for historical Frankengate/Bifrost logs, OTLP/OpenInference archives, ATIF, native Claude/Codex/Pi histories, canonical bundles, and explicit partner adapters. Raw archives remain in object storage; PostgreSQL owns manifests, identity and authority mappings, append-only staging, loss and quarantine receipts, promotion releases, deletion lineage, and derived-artifact invalidation. Do not write one-off import scripts directly into analytics, vector, eval, or memory tables.
acceptance_criteria: A tenant can register a versioned archive, receive a content-minimized dry-run, resolve identity and authority mappings, promote idempotent fenced chunks, inspect zero-unexplained-loss receipts and quarantine, and roll back or delete with transitive invalidation of text/vector/aggregate/eval/memory derivatives. Adapters preserve source identity, event ordering, parent/link/tool-call/result semantics, manifests, hashes, and explicit missingness. RLS tests fail closed for wrong tenant/subject/team/purpose/classification, stale epochs, deleted sources, replica lag, ambiguous mappings, schema drift, and worker restart.

title: Evaluate researcher traces and versioned harness memory
description: Admit source-pinned real researcher trajectories and versioned MEMORY.md/CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/rules/skills/plans/todos/notebook/document context. Preserve valid/system time, source lineage, review state, supersession/contradiction, authority intersection, availability, and observed load/citation separately. Run signal, retrieval, memory attribution, consolidation/rollback, and prospective cross-user support arms without backward leakage from final papers or current memory.
acceptance_criteria: At least one real researcher longitudinal corpus and one paired trace/context-revision corpus are source-pinned and admitted with loss receipts. R0 proves no future, stale, unauthorized, or deleted memory can enter an earlier query. R1-R3 compare cheap signals, exact/structured/FTS/vector/hybrid retrieval, and no-memory/relevant/placebo/stale/oracle/raw-evidence arms on user/project/source/time-disjoint splits with independent outcomes. R4 proves reviewed consolidation, contradiction, supersession, rollback, and deletion closure. No employee-skill, productivity, collaborator, or causal-benefit claim is made without governed labels and a prospective outcome.
notes: 2026-07-31 coverage checkpoint: memory-focused tests ran 92/92 from research package root with no failures. Enterprise-question matrix records personal-history mechanics as supported, friction/eval as bounded, and durable memory/skills/education/cross-user claims as unproven or deferred. See experiments/summaries/enterprise-question-coverage-matrix-2026-07-31.md. Existing cohort evidence still lacks powered context-revision splits, independent labels, and causal outcomes.

title: Run governed enterprise NL2SQL skill-learning factorial
description: Audit 60-120 executable enterprise-representative NL2SQL tasks and split by database/schema family. Run fixed-model/tool/seed arms for no skill, single-failure reflection, pooled success/failure contrast, held-out selection, Signals+AgentRx+pooled proposals, and unrelated placebo. Preserve schema/document retrieval, clarification, tool calls, execution errors, repairs, result verification, cost and authorization. Use the governed proposer/evaluator/releaser/runtime lifecycle and keep SpreadsheetBench only as a cross-domain control.
acceptance_criteria: At least 60 audited executable tasks span multiple schema families; no family crosses proposal/selection/test. Every task pins schema, database state, expected result/refusal, business-rule evidence, tool schema and source receipt. Arms report success, execution accuracy, clarification/repair burden, turns, tokens, cost, latency, unsafe actions and unauthorized access. Any security violation vetoes release. A candidate must beat no-skill and unrelated placebo on held-out families without material critical-family regression. Negative/null results are published; Aurora and general retrieval remain defaults until a frozen bottleneck passes its replacement gate.
notes: 2026-07-30 empirical checkpoint: froze the 93-task primary four-fold contract and cache-disabled MLX 0.31.3 Qwen3.5-9B runtime. Fixed mutable-main request resolution by requiring default_model; froze model snapshot 319aed167e31e0bf81ddba0c23f8d218a15be612 and disabled cross-episode prompt cache. Hardened SQL policy against sensitive use in WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, windows, functions, and correlated subqueries; fixed and verified governed search_path and strict label-aware metric. Full 96-task replay requalification is unchanged: 93 default matches, 2 entitlement-only matches, 1 invalid task quarantined, all security controls pass; aggregate sha256 ad8703c93be04cc5c70faf4c2612693e84be420e85d7810fb6377cc11f681278. P0 ran 12 paired native-tool episodes: all authority valid, zero unauthorized observations, every arm solved the same 2 of 4 tasks. Terminal failures were no-skill 25 percent, placebo 50 percent, expert 25 percent, so both protocol and paired-win gates failed; P1 and hidden remain sealed. P0 aggregate sha256 508c78b367a791e125f83c5dfdc1f82d2363ef558d9d299812c448fe683ec250. Full offline verify: 259 tests, 6 expected skips, 29 aggregate results, 37 dataset manifests, 12 governed fixtures, zero raw corpus files. New blockers tracked in children .1.1.2 capability isolation and .1.1.3 terminal protocol remediation.

title: Curate and harden Spider2 enterprise SQL external-validity cohort
description: Turn the pinned Spider2 source audit into a content-free, schema-family-disjoint external-validity cohort after the Defog factorial is stable. Repair or replace permissive Lite and DBT comparators, fix the ordinary-action double env.step execution, bound tools and databases, adapt typed tool calls/observations into canonical trajectories with loss receipts, and preserve raw task/project/database/transcript content outside Git.
acceptance_criteria: A frozen manifest selects 60 DBT tasks from the 62 alias-repaired self-consistent cases and an independently audited Lite cohort split by database family. Gold-vs-gold is reflexive; comparators preserve row tuples, multiplicity, nulls, order, and reject extra columns. Every agent action executes once and is recorded with typed arguments/results, IDs, timing, exit status, model/release exposure, authority epoch, and loss receipt. Execution is network- and resource-bounded under constrained roles. No benchmark content enters the skill-mining index. Baseline/placebo/best-Defog-skill arms report semantic lift, regressions, security/refusal, tool use, latency, tokens, and cost.

title: Seal NL2SQL solver evaluator and hidden-stage capability boundaries
description: Split the governed Defog model episode from task/gold resolution and evaluation. Generate capability-specific evidence, selection, and hidden stage manifests; run the solver without source checkout, gold, evaluator, hidden IDs, network, filesystem, cross-episode memory/cache, or unchecked database capability. Evaluate only immutable submitted-attempt receipts in a separate role/process and do not re-execute the selected candidate.
acceptance_criteria: The solver DTO contains only question, official instructions, current authorized database handle, artifact exposure, and limits. The evaluator alone can resolve gold/adjudications and execute gold alternatives. submit_sql selects an already executed attempt ID with no duplicate execution. Evidence/selection/test manifests are separately hashed and mounted only to allowed roles. Integration tests prove gold/source/hidden data and cross-fold state are unavailable, stale authority epochs fail closed, and every result carries model/tool/evaluator/database/authority hashes. P1 and hidden runs remain blocked until this bead closes.
notes: 2026-07-30 checkpoint: 61/61 capability tests plus 283 broader tests (6 skipped) pass. Separate resolver methods, signed gold envelope, fresh-process inherited-FD solver, exact OCI contract, and stage sealing are implemented. Real Colima Linux/runc run passes 21 enforcement/protocol gates after exposing and fixing missing fstatfs and host-global RLIMIT_NPROC coupling. Real PostgreSQL 16 run passes distinct candidate/evaluator roles, write denial, 3+3 lane executions, snapshot stability, and cleanup. Still open: minimal image, episode-specific UID/two-run isolation, SO_PEERCRED/durable resolver capabilities, independently signed broker/server execution receipts, crash recovery, complete stage generation, OTel receipts, and one same-profile 27-gate run. P1/hidden remain blocked.

title: Remediate NL2SQL terminal tool protocol before effect screening
description: Use an independent protocol fixture, not Defog selection or hidden outcomes, to compare the frozen current loop against arm-independent terminal remediations: explicit remaining budgets, terminal-only tool availability after the last successful attempt, and a stronger pinned native-tool model. Preserve the current loop as a negative control and rerun the complete four-task P0 under new hashes before P1.
acceptance_criteria: Protocol variants are frozen before any outcome, use no Defog selection/hidden task or result, and differ identically across no-skill/placebo/expert arms. Native tool calls and every failed/limited/terminal observation are traced. The chosen variant has zero unauthorized observations, no arm above 10 percent terminal/protocol failure on an adequate independent fixture, and no hidden correctness feedback. A new cache-disabled 12-episode P0 under new hashes satisfies the same gate before P1 can start; null results are published.
notes: 2026-07-30 fresh repaired P0: an arm-independent explicit terminal state plus terminal-only submit_sql/abstain phase eliminated missing terminal actions from 4/12 to 0/12 across real native model tool calls and disposable PostgreSQL. All 12 episodes ended in explicit submit_sql, selected a previously executed authorized attempt, and had zero unauthorized observations. Semantic results remain no-skill 2/4, placebo 2/4, expert 2/4; expert versus each control is 0 wins, 0 losses, 4 ties. Protocol gate now passes but intervention-sensitivity gate fails, so P1, hidden families, and trace-mined arms remain sealed. Keep this bead open until the harness demonstrates visible sensitivity without label leakage.

title: Implement strict NL2SQL capability DTO and IPC contracts
description: Implement closed solver and broker DTOs, bounded length-prefixed framing, opaque nonces and handles, HMAC episode references, and adversarial schema tests.
acceptance_criteria: Closed schemas reject all secret/unknown fields recursively; canonical framing and duplicate rejection pass; opaque handles/nonces and HMAC stage references have adversarial tests; solver DTO contains only the six allowed top-level fields.
notes: Solver DTO slice implemented: exact closed fields, artifact hash binding, 16 MiB frame, duplicate rejection, restricted JCS, opaque 128/192/256-bit tokens, HMAC episode refs. Four adversarial tests pass. Broker request/response framing still in progress.
close_reason: Closed solver/broker DTOs, recursive unknown-field rejection, bounded canonical framing, one-use nonce/request shapes, opaque 128/192/256-bit tokens, HMAC episode references, and adversarial schemas all implemented and covered by the 48-test capability suite.

title: Implement append-once NL2SQL attempt ledger and governed broker
description: Move candidate execution and exact-current authority checks into a broker-owned capability. Seal complete typed results once, close ledgers atomically, and make submit select durable evidence without SQL execution.
acceptance_criteria: Attempt evidence is create-exclusive, no-follow, fsynced, content-addressed, chain-verified, episode-scoped, and immutable; submit performs zero database calls; broker revalidates exact-current authority before every observation, execution, and submission.
notes: Component broker/ledger gate passes: source-neutral SQL policy import closure; exact-current authority per operation; closed typed query-result schema; one candidate execution; canonical full-result hash; create-exclusive fsynced chain; episode-scoped submit with zero DB calls; adversarial revocation/replay/cross-episode/policy/budget/catalog/result-limit tests. Real PostgreSQL 16 slice adds distinct NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS candidate/evaluator roles, application identities, write denial, 3 candidate + 3 evaluator-only gold calls, database snapshot stability, and full cleanup. Still open under child .2.1: signed independent broker/server receipts, crash recovery/WORM, backend identity binding, and same-profile integration.

title: Split sign and encrypt NL2SQL stage manifests
description: Generate separately signed evidence, visible-selection, and hidden-test manifests; HMAC task references; encrypt hidden membership; require signed candidate and gate receipts before one-time unseal.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence, selection, and hidden manifests are disjoint and signed; hidden is encrypted before the gate; mutation of any artifact, model, policy, authority, database, or gate hash fails closed; unseal is one-time and audited.
notes: Component stage sealing passes 7 tests: canonical Ed25519 manifests and candidate receipts, content-free commitment, recipient-bound X25519/HKDF/ChaCha20 envelope, exact signed pass-only unseal authorization, four recursively closed schemas, tamper/wrong-recipient/context/candidate/replay rejection. Still open for pairwise-disjoint stage generation from the frozen design, crash-durable one-time unseal/audit, atomic artifact publication, and managed key lifecycle; prototype is not age wire format.

title: Run one-episode NL2SQL solver in an isolated process profile
description: Run a fresh solver process per episode with read-only code, empty tmpfs, no source, gold, manifests, credentials, TCP, DNS, persistent home, or cross-episode cache; only inherited broker and fixed-model Unix descriptors.
acceptance_criteria: OCI integration proves no source/gold/manifests/credentials/network/persistent state are visible to solver; only bounded DTO plus broker/model Unix FDs work; every episode receives fresh UID, tmpfs, handles, and model namespace.
notes: One real frozen Colima Linux 6.8/aarch64 + runc 1.1.14 profile passes all 21 enforcement/protocol gates: read-only root, three owned 0700 tmpfs mounts, zero capabilities, NoNewPrivs, seccomp, AF_INET/6 socket denial, exact FDs 0-4, working inherited broker/model peers, exact staged app files, named sensitive paths absent, sanitized environment, zero canary findings, cleanup. Runtime testing found/fixed missing fstatfs and invalid RLIMIT_NPROC host-UID coupling. Still open: child .4.1 minimal rootfs + per-episode UID/two-run state isolation, child .4.2 production kernel matrix, production peer auth/model namespace, and final experiment image.

title: Separate NL2SQL gold evaluation from stored candidate evidence
description: Implement evaluator-only gold resolution and execution, typed full-result comparison, snapshot drift rejection, and auditable proof that candidate execution count remains exactly one.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluator can resolve and execute gold but cannot call candidate execution; full typed stored result drives verdict; candidate execution counter remains one before and after evaluation; snapshot drift yields infrastructure-invalid.
notes: Evaluator core has 9 tests for full typed evidence, bindings, authority, duplicates/order/numeric semantics, preview independence, and candidate count before/after. Resolver adds separate supervisor/evaluator capability maps and public methods, one-use nonce, experiment/fold/stage/episode/snapshot/expiry binding, strict SolverEpisodeDTO, and domain-separated Ed25519 gold envelope; 6 tests pass. Real PostgreSQL roles/snapshot drift guard passes. Still open: child .5.1 Unix SO_PEERCRED and durable capabilities, evaluator-only process/credential, signed evaluation receipt, independent broker/server candidate-count proof, and final OCI integration.

title: Bind NL2SQL capability events into OTel and canonical receipts
description: Emit content-safe resolver, solver, broker, attempt, submission, and evaluator events with complete component hashes, OTel links between solver and evaluation traces, and loss-aware canonical projection.
acceptance_criteria: Separate solver and evaluator traces link without flattening; every required component hash is present; restricted content never enters OTel; canonical projection preserves ordered calls/results/submission/evaluation and emits a loss receipt.

title: Run the governed NL2SQL P1 effect screen after both gates
description: Run the preregistered 23-task paired effect screen only after capability isolation and terminal-protocol remediation both close and a newly versioned 12-episode P0 passes.
acceptance_criteria: Both prerequisite beads are closed; a fresh complete 12-episode P0 under final hashes passes complete receipts, zero unauthorized observations, at most 10 percent protocol failure per arm, and the preregistered sensitivity gate; P1 runs exactly the frozen paired schedule and publishes null results.

title: Unseal the governed NL2SQL hidden stage only after signed P1 gate
description: Keep hidden membership encrypted and unavailable until frozen candidates, capability-isolation receipts, and the visible P1 selection gate are signed; then perform one audited unseal and evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: Hidden ciphertext is unchanged and inaccessible before a valid signed unseal authorization; authorization binds every candidate, P1 gate, model, tool, policy, comparator, database, and authority hash; unseal occurs once; hidden evaluation emits complete governed receipts without feeding outcomes back into candidates.

title: Finish per-episode solver identity and minimal rootfs isolation
description: Replace the common fixed solver UID and general Python image with an episode-scoped UID/GID and minimal immutable rootfs; run two back-to-back episodes proving distinct PID/user/mount/model/cache namespaces, no extra executable surface, and no cross-episode state.
acceptance_criteria: Two real OCI episodes use distinct allocated UID/GID and namespace identities; only allowlisted runtime/code files exist; shell/package-manager/extra interpreters are absent; handles/tmpfs/model namespace differ; episode B cannot observe any episode-A state; all controls pass in the final experiment image.

title: Bind NL2SQL resolver methods to OS peer credentials and durable capabilities
description: Put issue_solver_episode and resolve_gold behind separate Unix socket paths and UIDs, authenticate SO_PEERCRED before capability lookup, persist capability/nonce consumption crash-durably, and revalidate live stage/authority state.
acceptance_criteria: Supervisor UID can issue only the redacted solver DTO; evaluator UID can resolve only signed gold; solver/broker/wrong UID are rejected before content; method tokens cannot cross; replay survives process restart; expiry and revocation fail closed; transport/framing tests pass in the final OCI profile.

title: Sign broker and PostgreSQL execution receipts with crash recovery
description: Replace coordinator-only execution counts with signed broker/server receipts bound to backend identity, application role, stage, snapshot, authority epoch, attempt blob, ledger, and submission; inject crashes before/after durable publication.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate execution is independently evidenced exactly once; candidate and gold backend identities are distinct; submit/evaluate make zero candidate calls; crash before durable seal is infrastructure-invalid and never retried; crash after seal recovers without reexecution; forged/reordered receipts fail.

title: Run solver OCI seccomp conformance across production kernels
description: Turn the Colima/runc enforcement runner into a versioned kernel/libc/runtime matrix and preserve both startup failures and passes. Verify the exact seccomp allowlist rather than broadening it for convenience.
acceptance_criteria: The final solver image/profile passes on every declared production kernel/runtime/architecture; any required syscall has a threat-model justification and regression test; diagnostic variants can never satisfy release gates; unsupported combinations fail before P1.

title: Validate NL2SQL as an enterprise skill-learning domain with a BIRD-mined causal pilot
description: Mine one frozen generalized procedure from evidence-only WMH BIRD database families, then test it in the governed family-disjoint Defog harness against no-artifact and length-matched placebo arms. Keep MAGIC, PT-BR, embeddings, extra databases, and pooled methods out of the first causal study. If the BIRD arm passes protocol, security, paired-win, and held-out transfer gates, preregister incremental ablations and later test interactive friction on BIRD-Interact plus external validity on curated Spider2 and finance/private-business-knowledge tasks.
acceptance_criteria: The terminal protocol and capability gates are closed before any effect run. One content-leakage-tested BIRD-mined procedure is frozen from evidence-only database families. The first causal study uses exactly no-artifact, length-matched placebo, and BIRD-mined arms on paired Defog tasks with fixed model, tools, limits, authority, snapshot, and decoding. Results report semantic correctness, policy acceptance, unauthorized observation, protocol failure, repair/degradation, attempts, clarification, tokens, latency, database execution time, result bytes, unsafe proposals, and expected governed cost. Any security violation vetoes release. The procedure must beat both controls on the visible gate and retain benefit on an untouched family before MAGIC, PT-BR, combined methods, BIRD-Interact, Spider2, or finance/private-knowledge expansion. Null results and claim boundaries are published.

title: Run audited full-cohort Trace Commons memory composition preflight
description: Hash-verify the complete pinned 28-history Claude cohort, execute deterministic verbatim, basename-latest, contextual-bitemporal, and inactive-proposal mechanics, run per-arm future and cross-project controls, and publish content-free results. Independent audit must close observation/revision, overlapping-session, future-evidence, hard-coded-control, configuration, and claim-boundary defects before publication.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned 28 histories and 17,991 records reproduce exactly; 67 qualifying interactions join; every aggregate is content-free and self-receipted; controls execute per arm; context collisions, temporal gaps, and session overlap fail closed; independent audit reports no P1/P2; complete pinned suites pass; results are committed and pushed.
notes: Completed in commit 195dd6449. Final v4: 50 observations / 48 unique revisions; contextual placebo 0/6 leaks; basename-latest 3/6 leaks; 1 exact / 2 stale / 0 abstentions; failed-job atomicity and model/human quality phases not run; all comparison power gates failed.
close_reason: Audited v4 full-cohort preflight published in commit 195dd6449; 293 trace tests and 61 capability tests pass.

title: Prove content-free governed memory lifecycle in PostgreSQL H5
description: Bind the audited full-cohort aggregate to a contextual-memory procedure and exercise forced RLS, role separation, hidden tests, gated release, exposure, influence, withdrawal, rollback, and content minimization through non-owner runtime roles in a disposable PostgreSQL 16 plus pgvector fixture.
acceptance_criteria: Twenty count/invariant and six expected-denial checks pass under forced RLS and separate proposer/evaluator/releaser/runtime roles; source identity binds to the audited v4 result; raw payload is empty; no trace content is stored; rollback leaves zero fixture rows; clean-checkout fixture pins the tested pgvector image.
notes: Completed in commit 06becb594 against PostgreSQL 16.12 and pgvector 0.8.1. All 26 assertions passed; residue was zero. This does not prove failed-job atomicity, concurrency, Aurora operations, or memory benefit.
close_reason: Bounded PostgreSQL H5 pass published in commit 06becb594 with 26/26 assertions and zero rollback residue.

title: Expand longitudinal memory cohort to preregistered power gates
description: Acquire additional independently published, license and consent receipted native Claude Code and Codex histories with serial repeated reads, writes, edits, corrections, contradictions, and full tool/branch provenance. Keep contributors separate and raw histories outside Git.
acceptance_criteria: At least 10 reconstructable pre-cutoff reads, 5 changed post-observation cases, and 2 exact cross-session transitions across 2 independent verified projects; every source has revision/license/consent/hash/minimization/takedown receipts; controls run per arm; no post-cutoff evidence enters selection; public contributors remain separate subjects; no person-trait or enterprise inference.
notes: 2026-07-30 checkpoint: source-stratified Trace Commons + top-level Fable clears deterministic 10/5/2 mechanics counts at 17/10/5. Fable is one synthetic publisher/home family, concentrated in two projects, and has no verified contributor consent. A content-free scan found 11 bearer-shaped candidates, so raw model egress is blocked. Parent remains open for sanitization, confirmatory diversity, and model/human gates. GitHub #112 updated.

title: Exercise governed memory H5 under failure concurrency and Aurora
description: Extend the bounded H5 proof with injected partial-job failure, deterministic concurrent promotion and withdrawal races, epoch and membership changes, deletion and export invalidation, independently verified content digests, fresh-catalog drift checks, and a real Aurora PostgreSQL conformance run.
acceptance_criteria: Injected partial-job failure exposes zero partial state; deterministic concurrency races preserve scope and epoch rules; deletion and withdrawal close all derivatives; content digests are independently verified; clean-catalog and real Aurora runs record versions, extensions, failover, lag, PITR, and RLS; zero leakage remains a hard veto.

Parent remains open for lifecycle remediation, digest/drift checks, and Aurora/RDS Proxy/failover/lag/PITR. GitHub #113 updated.

title: Run frozen memory extractor and blinded human review after power gates
description: After the longitudinal and governed-database gates close, run the pinned atomic extractor and proposal-only dream arm on identical pre-cutoff evidence, then conduct blinded two-reviewer support labels with independent adjudication. Do not use this phase to rescue an underpowered corpus.
acceptance_criteria: Power and H5 predecessor beads are closed; every extraction receives identical pre-cutoff evidence and emits strict evidence citations; raw outputs remain quarantined; reviewers are blinded to arm and later natural actions; labels and adjudication follow the frozen rubric; unsupported active promotions remain zero; results report support, contradiction, insufficiency, stability, review time, and negative/null findings without enterprise transfer claims.

title: Run local governed memory H5 failure and concurrency gate
description: Run deterministic content-free failed-job, promotion, withdrawal, exposure, epoch, membership, deletion, and provenance schedules against the disposable PostgreSQL H5 lab; publish both passes and architecture gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Failed job leaves zero partial rows; promotion and withdrawal schedules use observed barriers; READ COMMITTED and REPEATABLE READ revocation behavior is recorded; exposure race and provenance deletion publish negative results; every run proves zero residue; no Aurora or memory-quality claim.
notes: Passed three complete PostgreSQL 16.12/pgvector 0.8.1 runs. Found active exposure metadata after withdrawal, old REPEATABLE READ authority/deletion snapshots, missing narrow governance writer, conventional event coupling, and FK-backed retention. SQL SHA ebf1064faef1466df973eb693cd4d2ffe1f0033e04b0371f25ffdbafca619ebc.
close_reason: Passed three deterministic local H5 failure/concurrency runs with zero residue; published both mechanics and architecture gaps.

title: Implement revocation-atomic memory release and exposure lifecycle
description: Replace direct release and exposure mutations with a narrow shared-lock lifecycle API that atomically rechecks authority, changes status, ends exposures, and appends immutable events.
acceptance_criteria: All release and exposure state changes use a narrow non-owner shared-lock procedure; exposure/withdrawal leaves no metadata-active exposure; direct status mutation is denied; every status change has one event; withdrawal/deletion invalidates retrieval and future influence; local and Aurora race suites pass.
notes: Created from the H5 concurrency negative result. GitHub #114.

title: Run governed memory lifecycle races on Aurora and RDS Proxy
description: Repeat the full H5 concurrency and revocation schedules on Aurora PostgreSQL and through RDS Proxy, including failover identity, reader lag, extension inventory, PITR restore, and zero-residue checks.
acceptance_criteria: Run the full deterministic race matrix on a pinned Aurora PostgreSQL version and RDS Proxy path; record extensions, parameters, failover identity, reader lag, PITR restore, transaction isolation, RLS behavior, cost, and cleanup; publish negative/null outcomes.

title: Freeze source-stratified Fable longitudinal memory mechanics
description: Freeze the pinned top-level Fable source stratum without paths or subagents, audit mirrors and overlaps, and reproduce source-stratified longitudinal mechanics without pooling user or project identity.
acceptance_criteria: Pin and hash exactly 79 top-level histories; exclude 36 subagents and every derivative; use content-addressed path-free receipts; reproduce 14 online, 9 changed, 4 exact-cross-session cases across 2 projects; verify mirrors and cross-source exact-overlap controls; prohibit user/population claims.

title: Gate third-party model egress without redacting internal traces
description: Keep governed internal evidence full fidelity. Before any third-party model call, transform credential/bearer/JWT/key/high-entropy candidates in a derived evidence copy, scan the exact outbound request, and fail disclosure closed. Do not run broad PII redaction on internal logs or mutate the authorized source.
acceptance_criteria: Internal users/admins retain useful trace content; local model analysis can use authorized internal content; third-party egress replaces credential candidates and applies only destination-required PII transforms; exact outbound request is rescanned; failures block network disclosure; receipts contain no values; internal source is unchanged.
notes: GitHub #115. User clarified 2026-07-30 that PII is acceptable for authorized internal/admin use but must not be exposed to third parties. The earlier broad sanitizer prototype was discarded before commit.

title: Expand exact-transition diversity for confirmatory memory claims
description: Add independent source families and exact serial context transitions until at least three source families and five source-scoped project contexts contribute exact transitions.
acceptance_criteria: At least 3 source families and 5 source-scoped project contexts contribute exact serial transitions under compatible pinned adapters; source-family mirrors and contributors are not double-counted; no population claim until the gate passes.
notes: Current confirmatory diversity is 2 source families / 3 exact-transition project contexts; mechanics counts pass but architecture-quality generalization remains blocked.

title: Run exploratory source-stratified memory model replication
description: Run the frozen state-selection, atomic-candidate, and proposal-only dream tasks over all 17 cutoffs with five-run stability and aggregate-only results. Authorized local models may use governed full-fidelity internal evidence. Any third-party model arm remains separately blocked on the egress gate. Do not claim population or enterprise validity.
acceptance_criteria: Run all 17 cutoffs across no-memory, verbatim, latest-only, contextual-bitemporal, and proposal-only dream arms with an authorized local model first; five independent structured runs; target/future evidence excluded; aggregate exact selection, abstention, stale/context error, citations, stability, cost and latency; any third-party arm must pass its separate egress gate; no active promotion or population claim.
notes: Protocol was frozen before model outputs. Privacy-boundary amendment preserves useful internal/admin access and unblocks a separate local-model arm; third-party raw egress remains forbidden.

title: Persist and reveal governed internal redaction mappings in OSS
description: Move phase-scoped reversible mapping persistence and authorized log-detail resolution out of the absent Enterprise wrapper and into Frankengate OSS. Preserve authorized internal PII evidence in a separate versioned envelope/key that may share the source row/deletion lifecycle but is omitted from ordinary projections and indexes. Require backend owner/team logs:reveal scope or reason-bound audited admin override. Keep credentials excluded and mapping objects absent from list/websocket/connector/error/telemetry/export surfaces; same-scope encrypted exports may contain resolved content after an independent gate.
acceptance_criteria: Owner reveal, granted team reveal, and reason-bound audited administrator reveal reconstruct only the matching input/output PII phase after backend authorization and scoped row fetch. User A, unrelated team, deleted membership, stale authorization epoch, and NOBYPASSRLS application role cannot reveal User B. Mapping ciphertext is omitted from ordinary projections/indexes and mapping objects never reach list/websocket/connector/error/OTEL/export. Authorized encrypted same-scope export may contain resolved content; third-party/public export is transformed. Encryption, wrong/missing key, legacy/malformed envelope, single-user-only plaintext mode, batch fallback, deletion, and UI tests pass; Enterprise-only resolver seams are removed.
notes: Code audit 2026-07-30: content logging defaults enabled, but Log.RedactionData is transient and RedactionMapping persistence/resolution is explicitly delegated to an absent Enterprise wrapper. UI already has a phase-scoped reveal toggle. GitHub #116.

title: Run Signals × diagnosis × AgentEvals changed-system replay
description: On blinded human-labeled natural trace episodes, compare random/length/cheap Signals selection; chronology/deterministic-invariant/AgentRx-inspired diagnosis with abstention; and exact/ordered/unordered/invariant/semantic stored-trace assertions. Replay every promoted eval in reset original, harmful-mutation, benign-mutation, and independently changed systems. Keep faithful upstream runs distinct from concept-inspired implementations.
acceptance_criteria: Passes only with blinded labels, task-cluster splits, cited evidence, reset replay, harmful-regression recall, benign false-positive rate, prospective changed-system catch rate, calibration/abstention, latency/cost, and no target leakage. Publish null/negative arms and reject composed chains that do not beat cheapest baselines.
notes: 2026-07-31 executable checkpoint: combined Signals/diagnosis chain, changed-system replay, and AgentEvals interop tests ran 21 total, 18 passed, 3 explicitly skipped, 0 failed. See experiments/summaries/signals-diagnosis-evals-test-checkpoint-2026-07-31.md. Existing Wisp result remains concept-inspired plus resettable opaque transition replay. Acceptance still open: blinded human labels, task-cluster splits, prospective changed-system task outcomes, calibration, and independent outcome verification.

title: Run multimodal OpenRCA-style incident diagnosis ablations
description: Construct incident cases with canonical trajectory topology plus independently timestamped logs, metrics, deployment/configuration, environment, and authorization evidence. Compare each modality alone and staged combinations against first-error, last-error, chronology, and blinded reasoner baselines. Require cited decisive evidence, alternative causes, calibrated abstention, and incident-cluster splits.
acceptance_criteria: Passes only if modality ablations use independently verified incident causes, timestamps prevent future leakage, evidence citations entail the diagnosis, alternatives and abstention are scored, and added modalities beat chronology without authority leakage or unacceptable latency.
notes: 2026-07-30 bounded concept audit against pinned Wisp c2c90b5: local Signals queue selected 11/21 and included tool errors in 11/11, versus length 7 and seeded random 2; descriptive only because no independent labels. AgentRx-style invariant proxy produced 11 hypotheses and 0 root-cause claims. OpenRCA was explicitly not executable on this corpus: no timestamps, metrics, topology, or environment snapshots. Result d82c5e0007106e9ae3e319d6d641691cc79ece00c2c79b1e03b7834d8069d454. Remaining work requires an aligned multimodal incident fixture and independent causes.

title: Compare relational temporal memory Graphiti LangMem Dreams and ReasoningBank
description: Run independent arms for latest snapshot, verbatim Memory-Palace-style history, relational bitemporal evidence, ephemeral Graphiti retrieval, deterministic/LangMem candidate extraction, query-independent released dream synthesis, and ReasoningBank-style success/failure procedures. Then test only preregistered compatible compositions with immutable pre-query release and later-task outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Each mechanism runs alone before staged combinations. Equal whole-item budgets, source/project/time-held-out units, online gold, immutable pre-query releases, contradiction/staleness/unsupported rates, later-task utility, correction burden, influence lineage, withdrawal, and deletion closure are measured. No label-only fake dream or product-name proxy may count as a faithful run.
notes: 2026-07-30 checkpoints: natural 2^4 latest/verbatim/bitemporal/evidence factorial over 23 later reads found every runnable mechanism/composition identical at 16 exact and 7 stale; corpus lacked historical/valid-time and semantic free-text targets. Faithful upstream follow-up pinned Graphiti v0.29.3/021d3a5 and LangMem 0.0.30 snapshot/56d8593. Both passed small real structured smokes only after exact lock alignment and think=false client injection. The 3-case natural run completed 0/3: Graphiti emitted four EmptyResponseError events on the first full input and hit the 600-second ceiling; no LangMem natural output was durably evidenced; no proxy or negative score was substituted. Result SHA eb708e4e3d8dc001d5cbbaab641bc396569147643c7bf142a6945ce4ae6ec73f. Next split LangMem independent natural execution from Graphiti full-input diagnosis.

Measure Recall@k, nDCG, exact identifier retention, hard-negative errors, subgroup effects, latency, deletion lineage, and transfer. Promote only with at least five absolute Recall@20 points on the hard slice, no exact-ID/subgroup/deletion regression, bounded cost/latency, and successful transfer to a separately held-out enterprise domain.

Record statistics age/cardinality estimates and bounded redacted plan signatures for personal history, structural events, proposal queue, FTS, and vector queries. Repeat under Aurora writer/reader, failover, autovacuum, partition churn, and restore.

Aurora writer and reader tests record statistics state, plan signatures, latency, zero-denial candidates, autovacuum behavior, restore and failover. A plan regression either fails readiness or triggers a documented native remediation before any sidecar proposal.

title: Run natural trace-derived skill transfer across models and harnesses
description: Use the same family-disjoint natural Frankengate trace cohort to generate a candidate skill from one harness/model and evaluate it on held-out tasks across at least two target harnesses (for example Codex/Claude Code-compatible replay) and two model classes. Include no-skill, formatting placebo, expert, trace-mined, SkillOpt, SkillGen, and RHO proposal arms. Never expose hidden outcomes to proposers. Record task-family/user/project/time splits, paired repairs and regressions, tool-call/terminal protocol validity, independent evaluator outcomes, cost/latency, rollback, influence exclusion, and model/harness transfer. Do not adopt a skill unless the candidate beats no-skill and placebo on held-out families with a preregistered regression floor and no unauthorized data flow.
acceptance_criteria: A pinned natural-trace manifest and source hashes; at least two model/harness target combinations; independent held-out family split; all required control/proposal arms; paired repair/regression table; verifier and protocol receipts; transfer effect with confidence interval; cost/latency; RLS and egress proof; staged signed release only after gate; zero live skill writes on rejected candidates. A typed null is acceptable when a harness/model cannot execute, but no aggregate skill-benefit claim is made until one complete matrix passes.
notes: 2026-07-30: NatureBench preflight (10 families x 5 arms), candidate audit (Opus-derived six-step procedure; 3/4 observed transcripts complete, including both timeouts), and first real local intervention are recorded. Ollama llama3.2:latest ran six paired synthetic episodes per arm: no_skill, formatting_placebo, trace_mined_terminal_discipline all matched 3/6 and had 3/6 text_without_terminal_tool failures. Independent Llama protocol control also matched 3/6 across all three variants. This is a reproducible protocol null, not domain skill benefit. Qwen3:4b endpoint attempt timed out due reasoning output (typed null). 2026-07-30: Added a governed visible-selection Defog NL2SQL pilot across four car_dealership tasks with the constrained no-BYPASSRLS role and real Ollama Llama 3.2. All 12 runs had valid authority and zero unauthorized observations; no arm reached terminal or semantic success. The trace-mined arm had 1 successful SQL execution versus 0 in controls but made more attempts, so this remains diagnostic and not causal skill benefit. 2026-07-31: Completed the same 18-episode native-tool fixture on Qwen3 4B. No-skill matched 6/6 terminal actions, formatting placebo 0/6, and trace-mined discipline 3/6; mean latency was 39.6s, 42.0s, and 47.3s respectively versus Llama 1.1-1.3s. The candidate is model-sensitive and harmful on this slice; no automatic promotion. 2026-07-31: Replayed Llama through Ollama native /api/chat as a second harness. OpenAI-compatible and native adapters both matched 3/6 on all arms with similar latency, validating normalization but showing no harness-specific effect. 2026-07-31: Ran four held-out broker tasks through both Llama harnesses under the constrained PostgreSQL role. All 24 runs were authority-valid with zero unauthorized observations, but every arm failed terminal submission; Qwen timed out before its first arm. This is a family-transfer protocol null, not semantic skill evidence. 2026-07-31: Added an arm-independent terminal fallback (submit most recent successful authorized attempt or abstain). Held-out broker produced zero successful SQL; car-dealership produced one incorrect trace-mined query and zero semantic wins. This separates terminal formatting from SQL quality but remains non-causal. 2026-07-31: Qwen native `/api/chat` one-task governed SQL probe emitted zero SQL tool calls in all arms; the controller abstained. This closes the local adapter question as a typed runtime null, not a quality result. Keep open for protocol repair, a domain-capable model/runtime, family-disjoint held-out candidate injection with no-skill/placebo/expert/SkillOpt/SkillGen/RHO arms, and independent verifier.
